heading: INT. FAMILY STATION WAGON, PARKED OUTSIDE A PLANETARIUM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. FAMILY STATION WAGON, PARKED OUTSIDE A PLANETARIUM - NIGHT
Rain beads the windshield.
The dashboard clock reads 7:52.
Across the street, the planetarium dome glows a soft blue, waiting for a show that has already begun.
In the driver's seat, a man in a thin wool coat grips the wheel, his eyes fixed on the building.
This is the STRANGER: late forties, heavy-lidded, thoughtful.
In the back seat, a girl of ten sits cross-legged, her ticket pinched between two fingers.
She watches him in the rearview mirror and says nothing.
The man draws a breath to speak.
Doesn't.
The girl unbuckles, leans forward between the seats.
We're late.
units.name: GIRL

units.text: I know.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Mom says you're always late.
units.name: GIRL

units.text: Your mother is usually right.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Is that why she left?
units.name: GIRL

units.text: He doesn't answer.
A raindrop slides down the glass.
The windshield wipers sweep once, twice.
What do you want me to say, Josephine?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Just say a true thing.
units.name: JOSEPHINE

units.text: The man looks at her, startled.
Something in his shoulders loosens.
All right. I don't know how to do this. I've never known. I walk into rooms and everyone's already decided who I am.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: You're my dad.
units.name: JOSEPHINE

units.text: Yes.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: That's all you have to be.
units.name: JOSEPHINE

units.text: His phone buzzes on the dashboard.
A name lights the screen: MAEVE.
He lets it ring.
Aren't you going to get it?
units.name: JOSEPHINE

units.text: Later.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: The phone goes silent, then buzzes again.
Josephine reaches over and answers it for him, putting it on speaker.
Desmond? Is she with you? The planetarium said you never checked in.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: She's here, Maeve. We're in the car.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: In the car? It started at seven.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: I know. I got us lost. And then I just... sat here.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: A pause on the line.
Rain on the roof.
Is she okay?
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: ^I'm okay.
units.name: JOSEPHINE

units.text: ^She's okay.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: They say it at the same time.
Desmond glances at his daughter.
She smiles.
Then go in. They'll let you in late. Tell them it's my fault.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: It isn't.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: Just go, Des.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: The call ends.
Desmond sets the phone down very gently, as if it might break.
So?
units.name: JOSEPHINE

units.text: So.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: He opens his door.
The rain is barely more than mist.
He walks around, opens hers, and offers his hand.
She takes it.
Let's go look at the sky.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: They cross the street together, small under the glowing dome.
